head: ChatGPT new model: GPT-6.2 Sol in Chat, GPT-5.6 Sol retires 23 December
dek: OpenAI is adding GPT-6.2 Sol to the Chat tab in ChatGPT from 23 November for Plus, Pro, Business and Enterprise users, less than a week after it arrived in Work and Codex. The older GPT-5.6 Sol leaves Chat, Work and Codex on 23 December.
details: OpenAI says this version of Sol is tuned for everyday conversation. It's meant to pick out details in photos more reliably, such as the symbols on a parking sign, and to follow instructions more closely when it searches the web; OpenAI's example is weighing a shorter walk against a lower nightly rate when comparing hotels, and it can offer to alert you when something you're shopping for drops in price. GPT-5.6 Terra also leaves ChatGPT Work and Codex on 23 December. The source doesn't mention the free plan.
where: ChatGPT Plus, Pro, Business and Enterprise, Chat tab, from 23 November 2026
means: If you pay for ChatGPT, GPT-6.2 Sol is now in the Chat tab, and chats that rely on GPT-5.6 Sol have one month left on that model.
todo: Pick GPT-6.2 Sol in the model menu and try it on your usual questions before 23 December, so the switch doesn't surprise you.
